working_tree: Uncommitted sidecar implementation and new conflict experiment; loaded source snapshots accompany each run.
label_policy: Unresolved semantic contradictions in the same subject/project/environment/time or attempt. Explicit recovery and supersession are compatible. Compatible does not establish current truth.
corpus_origin: Authored synthetic, informed by inspected production code and tests; labels and prompts fixed before any new model calls. Not a production sample or independent holdout.
scheduling: Sequential arms; fixed case ordering; no arm-to-arm compute contention.
isolation: Separate worker processes/artifacts; no production DB; no model loading or service changes; external Jev requests contain synthetic inputs only.
local_server: Existing local inference server shared with production workloads and caches; background load and cache effects are not controlled.
latency_scope: Single-attempt pooled HTTP plus local decision logic, excluding worker startup and artifact serialization; not end-to-end Hippo latency.
quality_denominator: 44 unique cases, 88 decisions per arm. Reversed repeats are dependent; errors/abstentions/missing count as incorrect. Pure rules judged both on coverage and covered cases.
analysis_policy: No post-result prompt or rule tuning in this run. Report both correct-per-attempt and correct-in-both-orders, false conflicts, missed conflicts and paired case changes.
